item.title: Military, state, county sign deal to open Kolekole Pass in emergencies
item.description: HONOLULU (KHON2) -- A historic military road once off-limits to civilians is now officially part of Oahu's emergency evacuation plan. Today, state, city and military leaders signed a Memorandum of Understanding formalizing access to Kolekole Pass during disasters. item.title: Hotel Street carries the history of Hawaii's earliest accommodations
item.description: HONOLULU (KHON2) - In the ahupuaʻa of Honolulu, which lies in the moku of Kona here on Oʻahu, stands a street that brings attention to Hawaiʻi’s early accommodations.
